purpose: Stage 6b of the Example 1 sensitivity study (user go-ahead, 28 Oct 2026; Reviewer 2: dimension-robustness of pCN): pCN at the fixed production step beta = 0.4313 (8 x the tuned beta at N_KL = 12) with the production run lengths (5000 + 30 000 discarded steps, 500 000 retained draws per chain, four chains, seeds 0-3, prior-draw starts) at N_KL = 24, 48 and 96, reported next to the N_KL = 12 production pCN run (production_v1, results/pcn_Setting1_Ex1_prod_v1). The earlier 4 x 100 000 runs at these N_KL did not meet the convergence criteria. Declared and frozen before the runs; a change of any setting requires a new manifest id and output tag.

prior.n_kl_note: N_KL = 12 is the production value checked against config.py; the stages override n_kl

model.plateau_bounds_note: joint-setting bounds of config.py, checked by the driver but not used by the v1 stages

data.note: existing observation files; their bytes are tracked in git and must not be regenerated

pcn.tuning: none during the production run (fixed beta)
pcn.beta_rule: 8 x the mean tuned beta (0.05391409064069336) of 4 tuned chains (target acceptance 0.234), selected from the Example 1 step-size sweep (1/2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 x) by the largest smallest bulk-or-tail ESS over all monitored quantities per PDE solve (rule chosen after the pilot)
pcn.note: beta, run lengths and seeds as in production_v1 (stage ex1_pcn); only N_KL differs

diagnostics.monitored: all KL coefficients and the junction depth at x = 0.5; c_p and c_n in the joint setting
diagnostics.undefined: an undefined R-hat or ESS of any monitored quantity means not passed
diagnostics.checkpoints: retrospective, on prefixes of the capped runs; costs from per-draw records; first pass reported with persistence, or 'not reached within the cap'

divergences.follow_up_rule: more than 0.5 % of the retained draws, or at least 3 divergences with 75 % or more in one chain
divergences.handling: report count, chain and location; keep the output; investigate the states; never change settings silently

timing.batches: one four-chain sampler batch at a time, no other heavy jobs on the machine
reported: aggregate worker time (sum over chains), sampling only and including warm-up
actual batch elapsed time from launch to the last chain end (epoch timestamps)
timing.excluded_from_sampler_timers: model construction and KL set-up (included in the batch elapsed time)

failure_handling: outputs are validated with check_run.py --production; an invalid output stops the driver and is kept for inspection; a valid run that fails the diagnostics or needs divergence follow-up is kept and flagged, never silently rerun with other settings
scope: Example 1, known plateaus (Setting 1): pCN at fixed beta at N_KL = 24, 48, 96 (stages pcn_nkl24, pcn_nkl48, pcn_nkl96), one batch at a time.

predeclared.reporting: for each N_KL next to the N_KL = 12 production run: mean acceptance probability and accepted fraction per chain, max R-hat, minimum bulk and tail ESS and their quantities, minimum ESS per 10^3 PDE solves (retained draws / including the discarded steps), checkpoint first pass, batch wall-clock time and machine load
predeclared.rules: the convergence thresholds of production_v1 apply unchanged (R-hat < 1.01, bulk and tail ESS >= 400 over all KL coefficients and d)
predeclared.not_met: a run that does not meet the criteria at 500 000 draws per chain is reported as not met; it is not extended
predeclared.changes: no reruns, extensions or setting changes after seeing the results without the user's approval
